hello_subtitle: UI/UX sandbox. No database, mock API only. Dev builds only.
hello_i18n_desc: Default locale lives in project.inlang/settings.json; currency and time zone in src/lib/config.ts.
hello_api_desc: GET /api/hello returns fixed JSON with no database call. Its message is translated on the server.
savebar_discard_desc: All unsaved changes will be lost. This can't be undone.
savebar_leave_desc: You have unsaved changes. Leaving will discard them.
demo_savebar_desc: Edit a field and the bar slides in. Try Ctrl/⌘+S, Discard, the link below, and the browser's Back button.
demo_invalid_desc: Locks Save without hiding the bar.
demo_fail_desc: The changes stay unsaved and an error toast appears.
demo_form_desc: Example form state, held in a Draft.
demo_notify_desc: Send a digest when something changes.
demo_save_fail: Save failed. Your changes are still here.
demo_shell_desc: Placeholder page inside the shell. Try the sidebar, the breadcrumb, Ctrl/⌘+/ to search, Ctrl/⌘+B to collapse, and a phone-sized window.
demo_shell_slow: Reports load slowly on purpose, so you can see the top progress bar and the spinner on the row you clicked.
demo_shell_unlisted: This page isn't in the nav, so the breadcrumb is empty.
table_stale: The list below hasn't been refreshed.
table_select_all: Select all rows on this page
table_bulk_confirm_desc: {count} selected items will be processed. This can't be undone.
demo_table_desc: Sort by clicking a header. Search, filter, pick dates, hide columns, select rows. Two tables: one in memory, one paged by a mock endpoint.
demo_table_memory_desc: 137 customers held in the page. Segments, bulk actions (Activate, Delete with confirm) and row actions.
demo_table_server_desc: One page at a time from /api/hello/customers. The first page came with the server render. Toggle slow or failing requests to see the loading and error states.
http_failed: The request failed. Please try again.
http_unreachable: Can't reach the server. Check your connection.
demo_forms_desc: The same schema validates in the browser and again on the server. Messages are translated; switch to ID to see them change.
demo_forms_api_desc: apiForm + SaveBar. Saves with PUT to /api/hello/profile, which re-validates with readJson. Try an empty name, a bad URL, 0 seats, or the email taken@example.test (only the server knows it's in use).
demo_forms_email_hint: taken@example.test is rejected by the server.
demo_forms_server_check: Send an invalid body to the server
demo_forms_server_check_result: The endpoint rejected it on its own, with the same messages:
demo_forms_email_taken: This email is already in use
demo_forms_action_desc: A plain <form> posting to ?/subscribe, validated by validateForm on the server. Enhanced with JavaScript, and still works with it turned off.
auth_login_desc: Welcome back. Sign in with your email and password.
auth_signup_desc: It takes less than a minute.
auth_too_many: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
auth_email_taken: An account with this email already exists.
app_start_desc: Pages under /app need a session. Add yours here; guard each with requirePermission when it needs more than a signed-in user.
app_profile_desc: How you appear to others in this workspace.
app_email_fixed: Your sign-in email can't be changed here.
app_password_desc: You'll stay signed in on this device.
app_revoke_sessions: Sign out of all other devices
app_settings_desc: Only administrators see this page; others get a 404.
users_desc: Who can sign in, and what they may do.
users_add_desc: They sign in with this email and password. Share the password privately; they can change it under Password.
users_ban_desc: They are signed out everywhere and can't sign in until unbanned.
users_delete_desc: Their account and sessions are removed. This can't be undone.
users_not_yourself: You can't change your own account here. Use Profile and Password instead.
site_tagline: Everything a web app needs on day one, so you can build what makes yours different.
site_hero_lead: Accounts, teams, roles and a dashboard, ready on day one. Spend your time on the part only you can build.
site_logos_title: Trusted by teams building for the web
site_features_lead: The parts every app needs, done properly, and out of your way when you don't need them.
site_feature_tenants_text: Every account belongs to a workspace, and the database itself keeps each workspace's data apart.
site_feature_roles_text: Admins and members out of the box. Add a permission in one place; pages and menus follow.
site_feature_tables_text: Search, filter, sort and page through thousands of rows, with bulk actions and exports.
site_feature_languages_text: English and Indonesian from the start. Adding a language never touches a component.
site_feature_fast_text: Pages render on the server and load only what they use. Nothing waits on a spinner.
site_feature_look_text: Switch the public site's theme in one setting. The dashboard stays clean and neutral.
site_steps_lead: From first visit to a working workspace in minutes. No setup calls, no waiting.
site_step_1_text: Sign up and get a private workspace, with you as its admin.
site_step_2_text: Add people, give each a role, and decide what they can see and change.
site_step_3_text: Your data, your team and your dashboard, ready when you are.
site_stack_text: Typed and tested from the database to the button. Read any line, change any part, and own what you ship.
site_stack_point_3: Tests for the parts that matter
site_testimonials_lead: Teams of every size run their work on {name}.
site_quote_1: We went from idea to paying customers in three weeks. The boring parts were already done.
site_quote_2: Workspaces and roles just work. Our security review took an afternoon, not a month.
site_quote_3: The data tables alone saved us a sprint. Our operations team lives in them.
site_pricing_lead: Start free. Upgrade when your team grows. Cancel any time.
site_faq_1_answer: Yes. Starter is free for small teams, with no time limit and no card required.
site_faq_2_answer: Any time. Upgrades apply right away; downgrades take effect at the end of the billing period.
site_faq_3_answer: In your own workspace, kept apart from every other customer by the database itself.
site_faq_4_answer: English and Indonesian today. Adding another language doesn't need a code change.
site_faq_5_answer: Write to us any time. Team and Business plans get priority replies.
site_cta_lead: Create your workspace in a minute. Free to start, no card required.
site_cta_note: Free plan · No card required · Cancel any time
appearance_style_lyra: Boxy and sharp, always square corners
appearance_style_mira: Dense, made for busy work screens
appearance_style_sera: Editorial and typographic, always square corners
appearance_not_allowed: This workspace doesn't allow personal appearance.
appearance_desc: The look everyone in the workspace gets, and whether people may pick their own.
appearance_colour_desc: The accent and surface colours, in light and dark mode.
appearance_style_desc: How components are drawn: spacing, density and shape.
appearance_radius_coupled: {style} sets its own corners ({radius}). Your choice comes back with another style.
appearance_allow_desc: Each person can override any of these from the palette button in the header. Turning this off keeps their choices for later.
media_unsupported: {name}: only PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF, AVIF images and PDF documents can be uploaded.
media_too_large: {name} is too large (the limit is 10 MB).
media_unreadable: {name} couldn't be read as an image.
media_desc: Images and documents uploaded to this workspace.
media_drop: Drop files here, or click to choose
media_drop_images: PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF or AVIF, up to 10 MB each
media_empty_desc: Upload files to fill the library.
media_stage: Image preview: scroll to zoom, drag to move
media_delete_desc: It is removed for good, with its thumbnail. Anything that used it will show it as missing.
media_pick_desc: Pick one from the library, or upload a new one.
demo_media_desc: The media components against a mock library of generated pictures. Nothing is stored; the real library is Media in the app.
demo_media_field_desc: Upload, choose from the library, or remove. The value is the media id.
demo_media_grid_desc: Three views. Click a picture: zoom with the wheel or + −, drag when zoomed, ← → or swipe to move. The drop zone only lists what you dropped.
editor_invalid: This text contains something that can't be saved.
editor_link_invalid: Links can go to http, https or mailto addresses.
demo_editor_desc: The rich-text editor with images from the mock library and template variables. Save sends the JSON to the server, which validates it and renders it for the app and for an email.
demo_editor_saved: Validated and rendered by the server
notif_user_joined_desc: When a user signs up or is added to the workspace.
notif_role_changed_desc: When an admin gives you a different role.
notif_empty_desc: What needs your attention shows up here.
notif_page_desc: What needs your attention. Handled items leave the list.
notif_prefs_desc: Choose what you're told about. Turned-off types are never sent to you.
demo_notif_desc: The bell, the queue and the all-clear moment against a mock inbox held in memory. The real bell is in the app's header.
demo_notif_bell_desc: Open the bell, mark items done with their check, or mark all read. Empty the queue to see the reward.
error_404_desc: The page you're looking for doesn't exist or has moved.
error_500_desc: Try again in a moment. If it keeps happening, let us know.
